baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_C3_IDENTITY_SESSIONS_RBAC_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN, PRODUCT OWNER APPROVED, 2026-09-09), section 3: 'idle timeout 30 minutes from last_seen_at, recomputed into idle_deadline_at on every request that passes E1; absolute lifetime 10 hours from created_at, fixed at creation and never extended by activity' -- named there as a proposed default, PO-tunable.
baseline.engineering: GateChain.evaluate refreshes idle_deadline_at on every request that passes E1 (session_reconcile heartbeat), so an idle session is one with no gated request in flight -- exactly what happens while an operator is filling in form fields, reading an error, or looking up a credential between requests. This is a one-value configuration correction inside an already-frozen contract; the contract's own §3 already states the correct number, so no new decision is being made here.

LocalAuthenticationConfigurationTest asserts the wrong 5-minute value, locking the deviation in rather than catching it. The Product Owner reported SESSION_EXPIRED repeatedly while working through the multi-step Add Device flow -- a wizard with credential entry, discovery polling, and candidate review that routinely exceeds 5 idle minutes between one gated request and the next. ABSOLUTE_LIFETIME is already correct at 10 hours and is out of scope here.
